name: Zaferan
headline: Zaferan
description: A source of curcumin, an extract from the root of the tropical plant turmeric. Curcumin helps reduce symptoms of indigestion, supports the work of the liver and gallbladder and eases inflammatory joint conditions.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.

Curcuma (Turmeric)

At the heart of turmeric's health benefits are its high concentrations of curcuminoids, which include the well-known curcumin. These biologically active compounds have been shown to support liver function by promoting bile excretion and drainage, while also protecting liver cells from the harmful effects of toxins and chemicals. But turmeric's benefits don't stop there. With its powerful antioxidant properties, turmeric can help prevent oxidative damage throughout the body and support overall detoxification.
